original_description:
Art Overlay helps you get a drawing from the screen onto a real surface. Describe what you want to draw, or share a photo, and say what you are drawing on: paper, a canvas on an easel, a wall, a cake or a mug. The plugin prepares a reference built for tracing by hand, with clean lines sized for your pencil, marker or brush and optional step-by-step stages for beginners. It then walks you through tracing it with the Art Overlay web tool, which shows the reference over your phone's live camera view so you can see the image and your hand at the same time.

It is for hobbyists, crafters, cake decorators, sign painters, muralists and anyone learning to draw.

Limitations: the plugin does not open your camera or send images to Art Overlay. You save the reference and upload it on artoverlay.com yourself, in your phone's browser. The tracing itself is done by you, by hand.
